response.original_title: Is head and neck cancer curable?
response.overview: Yes, head and neck cancer can be curable, especially when it is found and treated at an early stage. The chances of successful treatment depend on the type and location of cancer, its stage, overall health, and how well it responds to treatment. For patients looking for a head and neck cancer surgeon in Ahmedabad, treatment may include surgery, radiation therapy, chemotherapy, or a combination of treatments. A head and neck cancer surgeon can assess the cancer and explain which treatment may be suitable. When choosing among best head and neck cancer surgeons, patients should consider cancer surgery experience, specialised training, treatment options, and follow-up care. People searching for the best head and neck cancer surgeon in India should also look at the surgeon's experience with the specific type of cancer. https://www.drsmitoralcancer.com/head-and-neck-cancer-surgeon-in-ahmedabad/
